requiredBoundaryCorrection.before: Universal identity of all real cells despite mutation, differentiation or other model exceptions
requiredBoundaryCorrection.finding: In this genetic-identity context, listing differentiation beside mutation as an exception can imply that ordinary differentiation changes inherited genetic information. Normally body cells can share inherited genome while differing in gene expression, appearance and function. This metadata should not teach differentiation-as-genetic-inequality. The actual two profiles/cases make no such error.
requiredBoundaryCorrection.afterCandidate: Universal genetic identity claims beyond the supplied normal nonmutating chromosome model; distinguish inherited genetic information from differences in gene expression, appearance and cell function.
requiredBoundaryCorrection.exactFixScope: Only this boundary metadata; no case/answer or operativeD restart required.
